issue.title: Keep server reachability current after reconnect and on cold start [Returning online and sync changes Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526).

**Severity:** Medium  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `09ff2fd` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible` (scenarios A.1, C.10, D.14)

## Summary

Server reachability ("online" = Fluent `/health`) goes stale after reconnecting and on cold start, so the header, the Sync page and the upload orchestrator can stay offline while the server is reachable.

Each NetInfo event starts a `/health` probe of up to 5 s (`src/services/connectivity.ts:4`, `:126-138`); results are applied in arrival order with no sequencing (`src/hooks/useConnectivity.ts:50-80`). A probe that failed while DNS was not ready can override a later success, and the state stays offline until the next network event or screen focus. The orchestrator uses the same subscription.

## Expected

The app shows online within seconds of the server being reachable (#38, #150), and the orchestrator reacts to it.

## Actual

- The header opens gray and turns green only after navigating back (A.1).
- On the Sync page, right after turning airplane mode off, Resume / Sync Now became disabled with "Can't reach Fluent" until reopening the page (D.14).
- Turning the cellular toggle on did not start the pending upload until reopening Sync (C.10).

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the app on Wi-Fi and watch the header cloud; or
2. On the Sync page with pending takes, turn airplane mode off.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Only the latest reachability probe result is applied (stale results are dropped).
- [ ] A failed probe right after a network change is retried (for example with backoff) until it succeeds or the link drops.
- [ ] Unit tests for out-of-order probe results and for the retry.
- [ ] Android device QA (A.1, D.14, C.10).

## Related

- Parent audit: #530 (epic #526)
- #150, #38, #546 / #559
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)

comments.body:
Also seen during the offline chapter assignment audit (#533): the upload orchestrator gets stuck as "offline" after a 404 followed by a brief connectivity flicker.

**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `main` @ `fb634e5` (without PR #559), `dev.api.fluent.bible`. Reproduced 3 times (Acts 6 on 2026-09-28, Ruth 2 and Numbers 7 on 2026-09-29), once also on a second Android device.

- After an upload 404, NetInfo reported offline ×5 within a second and the orchestrator logged "Upload paused silently (server unreachable)".
- From then on, Sync Now ran only the metadata sync and started no upload session; the Home header kept the syncing icon. Only relaunching the app started a new upload session, which uploaded the pending takes at once.
- The same 404 was classified inconsistently: marked failed (`retryable: false`) in one session and "paused silently (server unreachable)" in another.

Suggested extra AC: after a paused session, the next Sync Now (or reachability recovery) starts a new upload session without an app relaunch; an HTTP 404 is never treated as "server unreachable".

Assessment: `docs/assessments/offline-chapter-assignment/README.md` (PR #609).
